notes: Access: tier-1 HTTP only, no block encountered. Same headless WordPress 'trouble' REST backend used as evidence source (see bs156.json notes for architecture). Found the site's own product taxonomy (trouble/taxonomy) contains a term 'New Collection' (term_id=1657, slug='new_collection', parent=29 which is the top-level 'Products' node - the same parent as the site's genuine Lighting/Outdoor/Furniture/Objects families verified working in the prior Home-Decor pass). This is the exact term the frontend's own '/products?type=<slug>' filter reads. The homepage (trouble/frontpage, ACF 'list' module) links this precise URL - https://www.andtradition.com/products?type=new_collection - with the anchor text 'Explore the new arrivals', directly tying the taxonomy term to the New-Arrivals concept in the site's own copy. qty verified the same way as the prior pass's 13 confirmed category URLs (the taxonomy API's 'count' field is broken/always 0): fetched all 410 product posts via trouble/list and counted unique product IDs whose 'tags' array includes term-ID 1657 - result 39, no duplicates. Recorded as the New Arrivals PLP. IMPORTANT distinct-page check: the site ALSO has a separate, differently-shaped page at https://www.andtradition.com/new-collection (found in the site's 628-route manifest and sitemap.xml; fetched via trouble/post?slug=new-collection). This page's post_title is 'New Collection 2026.02' and its ACF modules are 'promov2'(hero video), 'layout'(editorial imagery+text), and 'linklist' (two hand-picked grids of ~6 individual PDP links each with packshot images) - a themed seasonal-launch lookbook/campaign page, not a queryable product grid with a count. Per the brief's Collection-page test this was inspected and EXCLUDED as a marketing/editorial landing page, distinct from and NOT to be confused with the genuine taxonomy-filtered /products?type=new_collection listing above. Also checked the full taxonomy dump and the 628-route manifest for New In/Just Arrived/Latest Arrivals/Latest Products/What's New/New This Season/Recently Added/Newly Added - no other term or route beyond 'New Collection' exists. Danish-language equivalents (Nyheder/Nyt) not applicable - site is English-only per prior pass, no localized routes found in the manifest.
